title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
hook_text: Agentic analytics is hitting its stride.
script:
Agentic analytics now drives business improvements in 48 percent of cases.
This is a jump from 37 percent just one year ago.
Lumi AI recently reported a 90 percent pilot graduation rate for its platform.
Generative AI previously opened enterprise analytics to everyone across an organization.
Now agents go further by automating entire workflows and taking action.
Reliability remains the main challenge for agentic workflows as errors scale.
Would you trust an AI agent to execute your company's strategy?
